difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in a composable pair where the composite and the second arrow are formally unramified, an etale morphism on top of the first arrow remains formally unramified. The proof uses the lifting criterion directly: given a square-zero thickening and a lifting problem, the etale hypothesis lets one lift along the etale morphism first and then invoke formal unramifiedness of the composite to identify the two resulting lifts. The order in which the two lifting properties are applied is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 2604-2654.
